title: A Good or Bad on Tracy's answer is kept beside the turn it answered (site_turn.rating), sent by the host dsh signed as the person who typed — the note never leaves the conversation
steps: S1: ratingOf over a put with categories, a put with a legacy category, a delete, an invalid rating and other events; ratedTurn over a log of two turns typed by two people.
S2: The built site-tabs plugin hears session/event with a rating of an open conversation, session/event with another event, and feedback/committed with a delete for a conversation dsh had not loaded.
S3: POST /api/sites/:key/turn/rating for an opened turn with negative + task-result, then null; then a turn the site does not hold, a rating 'meh', a category '<b>', a turn id that is not one.
expect: S1: the rating and its categories only; null rating for a delete; none for the rest; the turn of the rated answer and the person who typed before it.
S2: exactly two POSTs to /turn/rating signed as that turn's typist — {turnId session-r1:2, negative, [task-result]} and {turnId session-r2:2, null, []} — and the note in none of them.
S3: 200 and the row holds negative, [task-result], rated_at; null clears all three; then 404 TURN_UNKNOWN, 400, 400, 400.
evidence: Plan #1403 item 13 (code read 16/10/2026): dsh's message feedback writes feedback/message-put to the conversation's log only; no reader on the host, so ratings could not be measured with their turns
fence: Only the judgement and its categories; the turn must be this site's

tests: ratingOf: the rating and its categories, never the note; a delete takes it back; anything else is none
ratedTurn: the turn whose answer was rated, and who typed the request before it
the built plugin sends a rating of an open conversation, and of one dsh had not loaded, to the turn it answered
POST /api/sites/:key/turn/rating: a Good or Bad kept beside the turn, taken back by null; nothing but this site's turns
